messages:
Jonathan: Quick heads-up — I found a mismatch between the REST /v1/generate and our Python/TS SDKs for how `stop` is handled. REST treats `null` as omitted, but the JS SDK sends `stop: null` and the server ends up interpreting it as an empty stop token list. Anyone seen this?
Maya: yeah saw a flaky e2e where a prompt kept truncating. traced to stop param.
Liam: JS `JSON.stringify` on an object with an explicit `stop: null` will ofc serialize null. Our SDK layer is turning undefined -> null in some codegen cases.
Elaine: On the server side our parser currently treats null as explicit empty array for legacy reasons. That's... confusing. We can change server to treat null===missing to be safe.
Jonathan: I think we should do both: quick server tolerant patch + SDK fix in parallel. Server patch buys us time for SDK release.
Maya: +1. Also the TS client has a separate bug where `top_p` becomes `topP` in the wire for some endpoints (camelCase vs snake_case). That's causing silent ignored params.
Liam: hmm I assumed our codegen canonicalizes param names, but we have mixed historical mappings. I'll audit the generator mapping table.
Jonathan: example payloads:
```
// problematic from TS SDK
{
  "prompt": "hello",
  "stop": null,
  "topP": 0.9
}
// desired canonical REST body
{
  "prompt": "hello",
  "top_p": 0.9
}
```
Maya: nice. Server patch should accept `stop: null` as if it was omitted, and we should add an integration test that sends `stop: null`, `stop: []`, and missing `stop`.
Elaine: agreed. I'll open a quick PR to the parser that normalizes null->absent and add tests. Will tag canary for staging.
Liam: I'll send a TS SDK PR to stop converting undefined->null and fix the name mappings for `top_p` / `topP`. Will also add a serializer unit test.
Jonathan: can we also add a contract test in CI that POSTs a matrix of param namings (snake/camel) for a few high-usage endpoints? this would catch regressions across SDKs.
Maya: yes please. if someone bundles that into a single small GH action I can wire it into PR gating.
deploy-bot: Deployment to staging scheduled: parser-patch v0.3.1 -> staging at 2025-06-12T14:30:00Z :white_check_mark:
Jonathan: pinging @Liam for review once the TS PR is up. thanks all — this one explains the intermittent customer reports. :thumbsup:
Liam: will do. I expect a small patch today and tests. :shipit:
